sender.quote: I value reliability, careful work, and the willingness to learn whatever is needed to support a team well.

sections.title: Why I am reaching out
sections.content: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Systems Administrator position at SecureNet GmbH.

sections.title: My background and possible fit
content: With over eight years of experience managing Linux and Windows server environments, I have developed deep expertise in infrastructure automation, monitoring, and incident response.
In my current role at CloudOps AG, I lead a team responsible for maintaining 99.99% uptime across 200+ production servers using Ansible, Terraform, and Prometheus.

sections.content: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience can contribute to your team's goals.
